See here for details: https://greaterthangames.com/content/volunteers-wanted-for-2016-pax-south-and-pax-east

 

 

I'm a rickety old man with crap knees. You wouldn't leave me all alone to shuffle around trying to help people, would you? Come volunteer at PAX South!
